title: One clean route into the roster
summary: Remove duplicate restored-session startup work and unblock the roster from optional profile loading.
changes: A restored sign-in now starts exactly one shared-roster authorisation path instead of requesting it twice.
Expired saved sessions are renewed once, and optional private profile details no longer hold the loaded roster behind the launch screen.
The interface, verified rotation, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, realtime, privacy and database rules remain unchanged.
